description:
List the saved logins this account holds — the `id` to name in a later signed-in call as `{ connection }`, which site, which account, whether it is still good, and when it was last used. A live one means a script can reach that site's signed-in pages with no sign-in step and usually no browser.

Useful before a task that needs an account: a connection marked `needs_reauth` or `expired` is why a run would pause and ask the user to sign in again. Adding a NEW login is still the user's to do, at https://bowmark.ai/dashboard/connections — `delete_connection` only forgets one this account already holds.
name: list_connections
title: See which sites Bowmark is already signed in to
